Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, R. BANUMATHI
F G H [2017] 2 S.C.R. 516 T. A. KATHIRU KUNJU v. JACOB MATHAI & ANR. (Civil Appeal No. 3860 of2007) FEBRUARY 16, 2017 [DIPAK MISRA AND R. BANUMATHI, JJ.) Advocates Act. 1961 - s. 38-Professional misconduct - Gross negligence - Allegation by the complainant that he handed over cheque to of gross negligence in discharge of his professional service to the client since he failed to get the acknowledgement from the complainant for having returned the cheque - imposition of punishment of reprimand and fine - Correctness of - Held: Nobility, sanctity and ethicality of the profession
Decision Date : 16-02-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3860/2007 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
